# Third-party notice: Signalsmith Stretch

The files in this directory contain the official Signalsmith Stretch WebAssembly/AudioWorklet release and its WebAssembly module build. They are vendored so this feature does not add a package-manager dependency or fetch code at runtime.

- Signalsmith Stretch 1.3.2, upstream repository `https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/signalsmith-stretch`, source commit `a670068d9aeb64913331d5cc29337b19a457a7df`
- Signalsmith Linear 0.6.4, upstream repository `https://github.com/Signalsmith-Audio/linear`, source commit `de55e6a50ffcf6f8f43f649692d94691c7025151`; Stretch's current CMake declares this as its DSP dependency and pins tag `0.6.4`
- Both upstream projects declare the MIT License. Full license texts are included as `SIGNALSMITH_STRETCH_LICENSE.txt` and `SIGNALSMITH_LINEAR_LICENSE.txt`.
- `SignalsmithStretch.mjs` is based on the upstream Web Audio/WASM release entrypoint (upstream SHA-256 `97530b11d5bc01015af4cde40d6aa55ff10c40aa1294ca4c8c5762027d517a46`). Its upstream Web wrapper source is `web/web-wrapper.js` (SHA-256 `4b380e40efee6c7a8ac3c9abce8911e7dcf77d659a91f771dd6db398715b5872`).
- Local integration patch to `SignalsmithStretch.mjs` (not upstream): future scheduled segments are retained while the input-time lookup is evaluated; `process()` prunes only segments reached by the audio render clock. Pending schedule entries are capped at 512 and scheduler exceptions are returned through the worklet RPC. Live processors accept a host-provided per-instance WASM linear-memory ceiling and initial preset, expose current linear-memory capacity and an acknowledged disposal RPC, and report initialization failure/ready timeout; the host enforces 20 pages (1.25 MiB) for LIVE_FX and 64 pages (4 MiB) for LIVE_POLY under a 128 MiB per-AudioContext reservation ledger. The cap exceeds the maximum 201 points used by a four-second PITCH BEND sweep at 20 ms spacing. These changes do not bound loop-buffer/JavaScript memory or browser RSS. The upstream version and MIT license are unchanged.
- Upstream source SHA-256 values at the pinned commits are: Stretch `signalsmith-stretch.h` `1188667959ac19dd40c0a6abbce694e44705615ec4f0e8db8af0f1cfb4c5dea7`; Linear `stft.h` `7422ff5ddc2a017dc0587dcce99ce5ba30a2414bc2996081f6b00d56905d9b8c`; and Linear `fft.h` `fb55f69ac14cdbac66b9c76053069ff63bc36d18af20d8c028b9acc0aad6516a`. The vendored Native copies differ only by removed leading indentation whitespace (and one whitespace-only space in Stretch): local `signalsmith-stretch.h` SHA-256 `ed7b282f3a8b8bcd62afd7668b8f2b9967c55a9b3d8ad1ec18d4f68e2d386315`, Linear `stft.h` `615f4e018d79b5d9943a9ab9b7e056a4e46f50ccdbb6f7eda5e4510ef8863193`, and Linear `fft.h` `490ba0f103e7fadee8ea5ffb2d5a748aa2e2b1fd50356edeb728da3cda5fb687`. Line-by-line comparison found no code-token or functional changes. The forwarding header and active dependency headers are covered by the Linear MIT license; optional accelerator backends are not enabled in this build.
- `SignalsmithStretchWasm.mjs` is the upstream Emscripten module build from `web/emscripten/main.js` (SHA-256 `f4af9d616062c67dbfe6a98d9bfd39f0149246f02c111122a10936f5c63d5cf6`) with the UMD footer removed as the upstream release Makefile does, then one ES-module `export default SignalsmithStretch;` line appended so the offline renderer and tests can import the same WASM implementation.

The generated WebAssembly contains the Signalsmith Stretch algorithm built with Signalsmith Linear. Optional accelerated backends and unrelated upstream test tools are not included. This repository has no overall project license; this notice is only provenance for these isolated vendored files and does not declare a license for the repository.
